verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              अथ रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामशेषो नागरो जनः। तत्राजगाम त्वरितो दिदृक्षुः पाण्डुनन्दनान्॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : When the night had passed away a large number of the people of the city came there to see the sons of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: निर्वापयन्तो ज्वलनं ते जना ददृशुस्ततः। जातुषं तद्गृहं दग्धममात्यं च पुरोचनम्॥२॥
verses.english: Those men extinguished the fire and saw that the house was made of lac and that the counsellor Purochana had been burnt to death.

verses.sanskrit: नूनं दुर्योधनेनेदं विहितं पापकर्मणा। पाण्डवानां विनाशायेत्येवं ते चुक्रुशुर्जनाः॥३॥
verses.english: The Citizens said : Indeed this sinful act was contrived by the wicked Duryodhana to destroy the sons of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: विदिते धृतराष्ट्रस्य धार्तराष्ट्रो न संशयः। दग्धवान्पाण्डुदायादान्न ह्येनं प्रतिषिद्धवान्॥४॥
verses.english: There is on doubt that the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana ) has burnt to death the heirs of Pandu, with the full knowledge of Dhritarashtra, else he would have been prevented (by his father).

verses.sanskrit: नूनं शान्तनवोऽपीह न धर्मनुवर्तते। द्रोणश्च विदुरश्चैव कृपश्चान्ये च कौरवाः॥५॥
verses.english: Indeed, the son of Shantanu (Bhishma,) Drona. Vidura, Kripa and other Kurus have not followed the dictates of duty.

verses.sanskrit: ते वयं धृतराष्ट्राय प्रेषयामो दुरात्मने। संवृत्तस्ते परः कामः पाण्डवान्दग्धवानसि॥६॥
verses.english: "Let us (now) send words to the wicked minded Dhritarashtra, (saying), "Your great desire is fulfilled; you have burnt to death the Pandavas."

verses.sanskrit: ततो व्यपोहमानास्ते पाण्डवार्थे हुताशनम्। निषादीं ददृशुर्दग्धां पञ्चपुत्रामनागसम्॥७॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said: They then began to extinguish the fire to find out the Pandavas. They saw the Nishada woman burnt to death with her five sons.

verses.sanskrit: खनकेन तु तेनैव वेश्म शोधयता बिलम्। पांसुभिः पिहितं तच्च पुरुषैस्तैर्न लक्षितम्॥८॥
verses.english: The miner, while removing the ashes, covered with it the hole he had dug in such a way that it remained unnoticed by all who had gone there. to

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते प्रेषयामासुर्धृतराष्ट्राय नागराः। पाण्डवानग्निना दग्धानमात्यं च पुरोचनम्॥९॥
verses.english: The citizens then sent words Dhritarashtra to inform that the Pandavas along with counsellor Purochana had been burnt to death.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु धृतराष्ट्रस्तद्राजा सुमहदप्रियम्। विनाशं पाण्डुपुत्राणां विललाप सुदुःखितः॥१०॥
verses.english: Hearing the great evil news of the death of the sons of Pandu, the king Dhritarashtra bewailed in great sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य पाण्डुर्मृतो राजा मम भ्राता महायशाः। तेषु वीरेषु दग्धेषु मात्रा सह विशेषतः॥११॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said: King Pandu, my illustrious brother, has (indeed) died to day, when those heroes (the Pandavas) with their mother have been burnt to death.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तु पुरुषाः शीघ्रं नगरं वारणावतम्। सत्कारयन्तु तान्वीरान्कुन्तिराजसुतां च ताम्॥१२॥
verses.english: O man, go quickly to the city of Varanavata and perform the funeral rites of those heroes and of the daughter of the king of Kunti (Bhoja).

verses.sanskrit: कारयन्तु च कुल्यानि शुभ्राणि च बृहन्ति च। ये च तत्र मृतास्तेषां सुहृदो यान्तु तानपि॥१३॥
verses.english: Let also the bones of the deceased be sanctified by the usual rites and let all the beneficial and great acts be performed. Let the friends and relatives of those that have been burnt to death also go there.

verses.sanskrit: एवं गते मया शक्यं यद्यत्कारयितुं हितम्। पाण्डवानां च कुन्त्याश्च तत्सर्वं क्रियतां धनैः॥१४॥
verses.english: Let also all other beneficial acts that ought to be performed by us for the Pandavas and Kunti be accomplished by spending wealth. Having said this, the son of Ambika, Dhritarashtra, surrounded by his relatives, offered oblations of water to the manes of the sons of Pandu,
verses.bhavadeepa: कुल्यानि अस्थीनि । कारयन्तु संस्कारयन्तु । ‘कुलं जनपदे गोत्रे सजातीयगणेपि च । भवने च तनौ क्लीबं कण्टकार्यौषधौ कुली’ इति मेदिनी । ‘कुल्यं स्यात्कीकसेपि’ इति च । कुल्यानि चैत्यानीत्यन्ये । महावृक्षेण वा महाप्रसादेन वा अङ्कितानि | चत्वराणीत्यर्थः ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततश्चक्रे ज्ञातिभिः परिवारितः। उदकं पाण्डुपुत्राणां धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः॥१५॥
रुरुदुः सहिताः सर्वे भृशं शोकपरायणाः। हा युधिष्ठिर कौरव्य हा भीम इति चापरे॥१६॥
verses.english: Being greatly afflicted with sorrow, he wept with all others! (saying,) Yudhisthira!" "O descendant of Kuru!" others cried, “O Bhima!"

verses.sanskrit: हा फल्गुनेति चाप्यन्ये हा यमाविति चापरे। कुन्तीमार्ताश्च शोचन्त उदकं चक्रिरे जनाः॥१७॥
verses.english: Others again, “O Falguni!" some again, "O the twins!” “O mother Kunti!” They thus bewailed and gave oblations of water.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये पौरजनाश्चैवमन्वशोचन्त पाण्डवान्। विदुरस्त्वल्पशश्चक्रे शोकं वेद परं हि सः॥१८॥
verses.english: The other citizens also bewailed for the Pandavas. But Vidura did not bewail much, for he knew the truth.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवाश्चापि निर्गत्य नगराद्वारणावतात्। नदीं गङ्गामनुप्राप्ता मातृषष्ठा महाबलाः॥१९॥
verses.english: Leaving the city of Varanavata, the greatly strong Pandavas, altogether six in number with their mother, reached the river Ganges.

verses.sanskrit: दाशानां भुजवेगेन नद्याः स्रोतोजवेन च । वायुना चानुकूलेन तूर्णं पारमवाप्नुवन्॥२०॥
verses.english: Aided by the strength of arms of the boatmen and by the rapidity of the current and favourable wind, they then speedily reached the opposite bank.

verses.sanskrit: ततो नावं परित्यज्य प्रययुर्दक्षिणा दिशम्। विज्ञाय निशि पन्थानं नक्षत्रगणसूचितम्॥२१॥
verses.english: They then left the boat and proceeded towards the south, fin ding their way in the dark by the light of the stars.

verses.sanskrit: यतमानां वनं राजन्गहनं प्रतिपेदिरे। ततः श्रान्ताः पिपासार्ता निद्रान्धाः पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥२२॥
verses.english: O king, afternoon much suffering, they at last reached a dense forest. The sons of Pandu became tired, thirsty and sleepy. Yudhisthira thus spoke to the greatly energetic Bhimasena, “What could be more painful then our being in a dense forest! We do not know the directions; we are incapable of proceeding further.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरूचूर्महावीर्यं भीमसेनमिदं वचः। इतः कष्टतरं किं तुन् यद्वयं गहने वने । दिशश्च न विजानीमो गन्तुं चैव न शक्नुमः॥२३॥
तं च पापं न जानीमो यदि दग्धः पुरोचनः। कथं तु विप्रमुच्येम भयादस्मादलक्षिताः॥२४॥
verses.english: We do not know whether the sinful Purochana has or has not been burnt to death. How shall we escape from the dangers unobserved by others!

verses.sanskrit: पुनरस्मानुपादाय तथैव व्रज भारत। त्वं हि नो बलवानेको यथा सततगस्तथा॥२५॥
verses.english: "O descendant of Bharata, take us on you again and proceed as before. You alone amongst us are strong and (you are) as swift as wind."

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो धर्मराजेन भीमसेनो महाबलः। आदय कुन्तीं भ्रातॄंश्च जगामाशु महाबलः॥२६॥
verses.english: Having been thus addressed by the king of virtue (Yudhisthira), the greatly strong Bhimasena took his brothers and Kunti (on his body) and walked on.
